text:
Sam (Eng - Oakland): Hey team — planning to relocate from Oakland to Dublin after my parental leave. I'm due back 2026-08-01 and want to move 2026-08-15. Questions: will my WFH stipend continue, what happens to 401(k) contributions/vesting, and do I need to file split-year taxes in the US/Ireland?
Nora (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: Quick list: payroll cutover timing, benefits enrollment in IE, stipend proration, retirement/401k guidance, and any shipping/relocation reimbursement. Can you confirm exact return date from leave?
Sam (Eng - Oakland): returning from leave 2026-08-01, target Dublin arrival 2026-08-15. I have an RSU vesting 2026-09-10 and ongoing 401(k) deferrals — how are those handled?
Priya (Payroll): Operational note: we prefer payroll cutovers on the 1st. If you land 2026-08-15 we can target IE payroll starting 2026-09-01 to simplify filings. That means last US pay will cover days up to your US termination date.
Tom (Finance): 401(k): US retirement plans can't be continued on Irish payroll. You can leave funds in the US plan if eligible, but contributions stop once US payroll ends. We'll provide guidance on rollover options and any timing impacts to matching.
US Tax: Split-year flag: you'll likely be US tax resident for part of the year and Ireland for part. You may need to file a US return for the whole year and claim foreign tax credits. State tax (CA) residency rules also apply — notify CA if you change residency.
Sam (Eng - Oakland): do I lose employer match if contributions stop?
Tom (Finance): match is tied to US payroll contributions. If US payroll ends before next match period, match may cease. We can model a pro-rated match for the year; need HR handoff to confirm.
Nora (People Ops): On WFH stipend: our global allowance covers Ireland, so recurring stipend can continue from IE payroll after cutover. Equipment reimbursements already processed in US payroll stay as paid. If you need a one-off top-up to equalize net pay, we can run a gross-up via IE payroll. Which do you prefer?
Sam (Eng - Oakland): keep the US expense claims as-is and continue stipend from Ireland. I'd like a gross-up if the net drops significantly.
Priya (Payroll): noted. For gross-up we need to estimate Irish tax impact; Payroll can run a mock calc and propose a gross-up amount.
EU Legal: Corporate nexus note: a single employee resident in Ireland creates an employer presence for payroll but not automatic corporate tax nexus for product sales. PE risk rises if you start signing contracts or meeting customers locally. Keep client contracting centralized.
Sam (Eng - Oakland): I won't be signing contracts. Mostly internal work and occasional remote customer calls.
US Tax: Also flag COBRA/health coverage — US benefits may end on US payroll termination; you may be eligible for COBRA. Check timings so you don't have coverage gaps until Irish benefits kick in.
Nora (People Ops): Good catch. We'll coordinate benefits overlap. Ireland benefits enrollment window opens 30 days after IE payroll starts. We'll aim to bridge health coverage via COBRA or short-term private cover if needed.
Tom (Finance): Shipping: relocation policy covers reasonable shipping; receipts/quotes go in the relocation case. If shipping is large, vendor-managed relocation might be used.
Sam (Eng - Oakland): anything on RSU vesting 2026-09-10? Will tax withholding change?
Priya (Payroll): RSU withholding will follow residency/payroll at vest date. If youre on Irish payroll by 2026-09-10, withholding and reporting rules will be Irish — which can materially change net. Finance should model scenarios.
Tom (Finance): we'll run scenario for pre- and post-cutover vesting tax impact and share numbers. Please add vest date to the relocation form.
Nora (People Ops): Next steps: 1) submit relocation form https://hr.redwood.example/relocate with passport, lease intent, and cutover preference 2) People Ops opens payroll transfer ticket 3) Payroll finalizes US exit payslip and schedules IE onboarding 4) benefits packet and COBRA overlap guidance 5) gross-up estimate if requested.
Sam (Eng - Oakland): submitted relocation form now. PeopleOpsBot: "Case #R-7124 created and assigned to Nora. Reminder: payroll cutover SLA 10 business days for international moves."
Priya (Payroll): Practical: please upload PPS number once you have it; until then we may use provisional tax coding. Also add Irish bank details for payroll deposit.
EU Legal: final note: if you start client meetings or local contracting, tell us so we can reassess VAT/PE risk. Otherwise low corporate risk.
Sam (Eng - Oakland): Thanks all — appreciate the clear plan. Nora, ping me what info you need for gross-up modelling.
Nora (People Ops): Will do. I'll also add a checklist here 2 weeks before the cutover. PeopleOpsBot: "Reminder: benefits enrollment window opens 2026-09-02 and closes 2026-10-02 for Case #R-7124."
